reason: B offers the more physically plausible and testable mechanism, with phase-resolved measurements, explicit temperature/strain-rate boundaries, a suppression control, and a decisive falsification criterion; A’s rapid stress-induced segregation/precipitation is generally kinetically implausible during high-rate or low-temperature loading. B nevertheless overextends evidence from dual-phase Cantor-like alloys to single-phase CrMnFeCoNi and treats the uncited 10–30% hcp threshold too precisely, so that threshold should be posed as a quantity to determine rather than an established value.
